title: TechNest
description: A modern tech product showcase platform built with React and Tailwind CSS. It features category-based browsing, responsive UI, and smooth animations for an engaging user experience.

title: Budget Tracker
description: A simple yet powerful web app to manage personal expenses and savings. Built with the MERN stack, it allows users to add, edit, and track spending with visual summaries.

title: RestroFlow
description: An online restaurant management and food ordering system developed using React, Node.js, and MongoDB. It helps users explore menus, place orders, and manage reservations efficiently.
